narratives.body: Morgan Hale, a basketball guard, has reportedly agreed to join the Bay Owls, according to an unnamed source told Arena Desk. However, the Bay Owls have denied any agreement with Hale, as stated by Club Ledger. Both reports were published on 2026-09-26T23:00:00Z.
narratives.headline: Morgan Hale reportedly joins Bay Owls; club denies agreement
